capacity_gross_kwh.notes: Estimated: Weekly Driver pack page lists the 2023 GV60 at 77.4 kWh total. Years compared 2023-2025: same 77.4 kWh pack (Genesis model notes; Fastned lists GV60 77.4 kWh for 2022-2025); nothing shows a change.

capacity_usable_kwh.notes: Estimated: 74 kWh usable on the 77.4 kWh pack (ArenaEV lists 77.4 usable / 82.5 total for the GV60; not used). Years compared 2023-2025: same 77.4 kWh pack (Genesis model notes; Fastned lists GV60 77.4 kWh for 2022-2025); nothing shows a change.

chemistry.notes: Estimated: NCM 811. Years compared 2023-2025: same 77.4 kWh pack (Genesis model notes; Fastned lists GV60 77.4 kWh for 2022-2025); nothing shows a change.

nominal_voltage_class.notes: Estimated: 697 V nominal; ArenaEV "697V (800V type)". Years compared 2023-2025: same 77.4 kWh pack (Genesis model notes; Fastned lists GV60 77.4 kWh for 2022-2025); nothing shows a change.

preconditioning.notes: Estimated: Genesis (Germany) GV60 page: Battery Conditioning System activates automatically when a fast charger is the route destination, or can be activated manually. The page is undated and not a US/Canada page. Same model in another model year (2023-2025 cars; years compared 2023-2027), no change found.

ac_max_kw.notes: Estimated: 11 kW AC (pack page; Hyundai US gives 10.9 kW for the same hardware on the Ioniq 5; ArenaEV 7 or 11 kW options in Europe). Years compared 2023-2025: same 77.4 kWh pack (Genesis model notes; Fastned lists GV60 77.4 kWh for 2022-2025); nothing shows a change.

dc_max_kw.notes: Estimated: 233 kW peak DC (Fastned GV60 77.4: 230 kW; ArenaEV 240 kW). Years compared 2023-2025: same 77.4 kWh pack (Genesis model notes; Fastned lists GV60 77.4 kWh for 2022-2025); nothing shows a change.

published_10_80_min.notes: ArenaEV relays Genesis: 10-80 % in 18 min (350 kW charger).
